programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha

programme.title: Barcelona F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's lights out for the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix. Lewis Hamilton makes a first Ferrari front-row start alongside polesitter George Russell. Kimi Antonelli lines up in third. (14.06)

programme.title: US Open Golf Final Round Hlts
programme.desc: The final round of the 126th US Open Championship at Shinnecock Hills Golf Club. JJ Spaun snatched Major glory last year with a two-shot win over Scotland's Robert MacIntyre. (21.06)

programme.title: ICC Women's T20 WC: PAK v BAN Hlts
programme.desc: Bangladesh face Pakistan in the ICC Women's T20 World Cup. (20.06)

programme.title: ICC Women's T20 WC: NZ v SCO Hlts
programme.desc: New Zealand play Scotland at the ICC Women's T20 World Cup. A first win of the tournament over Ireland kept defending champions New Zealand's semi-final hopes alive. (23.06)

programme.title: Live ICC Women's T20 WC: ENG v WI
programme.desc: England's toughest Women's T20 World Cup test so far awaits as an unbeaten West Indies arrive at Lord's. The hosts' record also remains unblemished, having collected three wins themselves.

programme.title: US Open Golf R2 Highlights
programme.desc: Round two of the US Open. Wyndham Clark set Thursday's pace with Rory McIlroy starting strongly, while a Career Grand Slam-chasing Scottie Scheffler kept himself in contention. (19.06)

programme.title: ICC Women's T20 WC: WI v SCO Hlts
programme.desc: Scotland eye back-to-back T20 World Cup victories with a clash against the West Indies. The Windies got underway with a comprehensive seven-wicket win over New Zealand. (18.06)

programme.title: ICC Women's T20 WC: AUS v BAN Hlts
programme.desc: The competition's most successful team Australia take on Bangladesh in the group stage of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup. Australia overcame South Africa in their opening game. (17.06)
